integration.about: The LAA build (project-laa.yml): every unit class and every UI class, against the synthetic fixtures.

exclude_classes.LAALabCaptureUITests: Capture tool, not a behavior test: it runs only from scripts/laa/lab/capture.py, which supplies its own fixtures and environment. Its pass/fail is capture.py's exit code.

smoke.about: The default Conduit build (project.yml): the merge gate's selection from scripts/smoke-suite.json.

upstream-unit.about: The default Conduit build (project.yml): every unit class. It proves that a test listed as not-applicable in the LAA build (it asserts upstream copy the LAA brand layer replaces) still passes where it applies.
